questionText:
Apex Fasteners establishes standard output of 120 units. Workers hitting standard earn Rs. 10 per unit; those below earn Rs. 8 per unit. Worker C produces 130 units and Worker D produces 110 units.
What is the difference in daily earnings between the two workers?

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct analytical application of NCERT principle.

options.studentSelectionTrap: Erroneously calculating the unit difference using only the lower piece rate.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Student error: Erroneously calculating the unit difference using only the lower piece rate.

options.studentSelectionTrap: Erroneously calculating the unit difference using only the higher piece rate.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Student error: Erroneously calculating the unit difference using only the higher piece rate.
Student error: Arithmetic miscalculation.

detailedSolution: Worker 1 reached standard: 130 units * Rs. 10.0 = Rs. 1300.0. Worker 2 fell below standard: 110 units * Rs. 8.0 = Rs. 880.0. Difference in earnings = Rs. 1300.0 - Rs. 880.0 = Rs. 420.0.

solution.quick: Option (A) is correct: Rs. 420.0
solution.concept: NCERT Class 12 Business Studies: Principles of Management - Taylor's Scientific Management.
solution.detailed: Worker 1 reached standard: 130 units * Rs. 10.0 = Rs. 1300.0. Worker 2 fell below standard: 110 units * Rs. 8.0 = Rs. 880.0. Difference in earnings = Rs. 1300.0 - Rs. 880.0 = Rs. 420.0.
